{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converters (converted == 1)
converters = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_converters = converters[converters['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converters['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converters)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converters)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding age=-1): {mean_age:.2f}")

# Output the result
mean_age"}
